text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. 白色露肩短袖抽褶束身短上衣，白色多层荷叶长裙带清晰高侧开衩，鞋未展示不加。仅服装与鞋袜；无可拆卸配饰。
original_prompt: Edit this neutral clothing-only catalogue photograph. Remove the two beige sandals completely. Show only the white off-shoulder cropped blouse and tiered white long skirt. Keep the skirt side slit clearly visible and all other details unchanged. Maintain pure white background, no person, no body, no mannequin, no text, realistic textile product photography.
